subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence cadence
messages:
From: Laura Stevens <laura.stevens@horizonbank.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire + evidence cadence

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this. We ran the SIG questionnaire against Redwood and the procurement team would like to collect control substantiation and artifacts for a handful of high-risk areas before our internal risk committee meets on April 5. Attached is the filled questionnaire (redline comments where relevant).

Key asks:
- Control mapping showing which Redwood control/feature satisfies each SIG control (single spreadsheet preferred).
- Representative evidence for encryption, key management, identity & access, change control, and telemetry (logs/traces).
- A proposed cadence for evidence delivery and a named owner for each control area.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether Redwood can provide the artifacts listed in columns G-L of the attached doc;
2) A realistic delivery timeline (we prefer split deliveries, not everything at once);
3) Whether we need an NDA amendment for any high-sensitivity items.

Attached: horizon_SIG_v2.docx (docx, 2.1MB)

Appreciate a quick ack and proposed next steps. If easier, we can schedule a 30-min kickoff next week.

Best,
Laura Stevens
Security Manager, Horizon Bank
laura.stevens@horizonbank.com
[attachment: horizon_SIG_v2.docx (2.1MB)]

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Laura Stevens <laura.stevens@horizonbank.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence cadence

Hi Laura — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. We can support the request. Summary below and proposed next steps.

Quick answers:
1) Yes — we can provide mappings and representative artifacts for the areas you called out.
2) Proposed delivery: a 3-week sprint with staged drops: week 1 (controls + identity & access evidence), week 2 (encryption/KMS + change control artifacts), week 3 (telemetry samples + final crosswalk).
3) There should be no need for an NDA amendment for the representative artifacts; any customer-specific logs would require scoped access — we can produce redacted samples.

What we need from you:
- Confirmation of the precise artifact formats you prefer (zipped PDFs, CSV exports, or specific templates).
- Any constraints on redaction (PII, account IDs) beyond the usual.
- Availability for a 30-min kickoff next Tue or Wed (I suggested times below).

I’ve looped in Mina and Karthik internally to own the primary artifact pulls — see internal assignment below. We’ll circulate an internal timeline and a Drive folder where we’ll stage the artifacts.

Proposed kickoff windows (PST): Tue 19 Mar 10:00–10:30 or Wed 20 Mar 14:00–14:30. Please pick one and we’ll send an invite.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
[attachment: redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx (stub)]

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Horizon SIG — artifact owners and timeline (please ack)

Team — Horizon (prospect) sent the attached SIG and wants a staged delivery by April 5. Assigning owners and asks below. Please ack and flag blockers by EOD Mon.

Owners / asks:
- Mina_haddad: Encryption & KMS proof bundle. Items: key rotation policy, sample KMS audit logs (redacted), config snapshot showing CMK usage. Deliverable target: Week 2 (by 3/26).
- Karthik_iyer: Identity & Access + Change Control. Items: RBAC matrix, sample IAM role change ticket(s), SSO config notes, MFA enforcement report. Deliverable target: Week 1 (by 3/22).
- Mateo_alvarez: Telemetry (application/infra logs) crosswalk and final control mapping spreadsheet. Deliverable target: Week 3 (by 3/29).

Format guidance: we’ll stage artifacts in a shared Drive folder as PDFs/CSVs and keep a single control map (redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx). If an item is sensitive, provide a redacted PDF and a short readme describing the redaction.

Risks:
- KMS logs may require legal review if they contain tenant identifiers. If you anticipate that, flag now so Legal can triage.

Mina/Karthik — please reply with ack and estimated hours. I’ll draft our cover note to Laura after we have the first artifacts.

Thanks,
Mateo

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Laura Stevens <laura.stevens@horizonbank.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence cadence

Laura — confirmed. Thanks for the quick turnaround on this request.

What we’ll deliver and next steps:
- Kickoff: Tentatively Tue 19 Mar 10:00–10:30 PST (calendar invite to follow once you confirm).
- Staging folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bRedwoodSIG (we’ll populate with versioned artifacts; redaction notes included).
- Initial drop (Week 1 by 3/22): RBAC matrix, sample IAM change ticket, SSO config export, control map (v1).
- Encryption bundle (Week 2 by 3/26): key policy, rotation cadence document, redacted KMS audit sample (kms_rotation_logs_sample.pdf).
- Final telemetry & crosswalk (Week 3 by 3/29): log samples, tracing excerpts, finalized control mapping (redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx).

Attachments included in this message (stubs): redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx, kms_rotation_logs_sample.pdf

If any of these targets are too aggressive from your side, tell us which controls you’d like prioritized and we’ll adapt.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
